rx_specific_lessons_extracted: RX macro requires explicit versioned register model (CDC_RX + CDC_2_5_RX); blind register renaming alone is insufficient.
For RX scale, component_probe split is a structural requirement, not an optional refactor.
Retaining downstream FIR-specific controls inflates code size without improving upstream alignment.
Route count parity can hide significant control/lifecycle divergences; controls and probe APIs must be checked independently.
